spell.ironspell_more.blazing_chakra.guid: Slam a blazing spear into the earth, unleashing expanding concentric ripples of flame across 12 blocks. Deals devastating fire damage up close that falls off with distance and incinerates targets.
spell.ironspell_more.lightning_strike.gu: Summons a lightning bolt to strike target area.
spell.ironspell_more.thunder_step.guide: Dash instantly forward, zapping all enemies along the path.
spell.ironspell_more.spin_strike.guide: Perform a fiery spin attack forward, piercing through enemies and dealing damage.
spell.ironspell_more.pure_white_flame_bu: Grab a target within strict melee range and fling them forward, triggering an explosive burst followed by a cone wave. Imposes severe recoil penalties on the caster.
spell.ironspell_more.shackle_of_fear.gui: Launches a projectile that binds affected targets with chains.
spell.ironspell_more.hymn_of_purificatio: Channel a 20-second Guqin melody with profound concentration, remaining completely motionless. Continuously heals all allies within a 20-block radius during seconds 1–19. Completing the full 20-second melody instantly cleanses all debuffs from allies in the circle. If interrupted by taking damage, moving, turning the view, or colliding with an entity before completion, the melody stops immediately, no debuff cleanse occurs, and all allies in the circle suffer 2 seconds of Qi instability (Nausea).
spell.ironspell_more.wings_of_tempest.gu: Summons a swirling tempest around the caster that traps and spins surrounding targets in an orbit, inflicting debilitating debuffs.
spell.ironspell_more.crimson_rain_bathes: Channel a tempest of crimson lightning and summon a barrage of crimson spears that pierce enemies and inflict wetness.
spell.ironspell_more.gale_drive.guide: Grants Speed II and Strength I while performing a 15-block piercing dash. Colliding with an enemy summons a powerful vortex that traps them in mid-air for 7 seconds, deals periodic damage, suctions nearby foes, and inflicts severe debuffs upon falling.
spell.ironspell_more.venomous_blossomfal: Charge an azure venom needle and fire it toward the crosshair. The charge stage selects projectile speed, range, and direct damage, while a direct hit also inflicts Azure Venom.
ui.ironspell_more.venomous_blossomfall_t: A visible living target is too close to begin charging.
ui.ironspell_more.venomous_blossomfall_c: Azure Venom Stage 2: Energy Waves — Range 60
Azure Venom Stage 3: Full Storm — Range 90 — Release to fire
spell.ironspell_more.glacial_veil.guide: Unleashes an expanding wave of frost and erupts ice spikes in 8 directions around the caster up to 10 blocks, dealing 20 damage and inflicting Frostbite for 10 seconds.
spell.ironspell_more.glacial_firmament.g: Unleash glacial power to create an ice domain of 15 blocks. Deals 35 damage and inflicts Slowness II for 3 seconds to enemies, while granting Speed II for 2 seconds to the caster, erupting concentric rings of glacial spikes and glacial tombs from the ground.
spell.ironspell_more.gale_piercer.guide: Infuse wind into your bow, locking onto a target in line of sight. Release early to fire a high-speed wind arrow with limited homing, or hold for 10 seconds to unleash a wall-piercing, perfectly homing gale arrow that ignites and slows the target.
ui.ironspell_more.gale_piercer_full_char: Gale Piercer: Full Charge — Release to fire Gale Arrow
spell.ironspell_more.tigershade_terrabre: Lock onto an enemy in sight to mark them for 60 seconds, gaining Speed II, Strength I, an energy wave aura, and revealing the target's position with a glowing outline visible only to you. If the marked target is within 5 blocks, recast to lunge and slam them into the ground, dealing heavy spell damage and restoring 10 HP if defeated.
ui.ironspell_more.tigershade_target_lost: Marked target is dead or unavailable.
ui.ironspell_more.tigershade_too_far: Target is too far! Must be within 5 blocks to slam.
spell.ironspell_more.resonant_knell.guid: Strike your weapon with a resonating chime to manifest a fiery gold-red barrier following you, granting Strength II, Resistance II, and Fire Resistance I to you and allies inside. Recast up to 6 times across 3 cycles to alternate between summoning the protective barrier and detonating outward nuclear shockwaves (15, 20, and 30 block radius) that launch enemies high into the air.
ui.ironspell_more.spell_on_cooldown: Resonant Knell is currently on cooldown.
spell.ironspell_more.rapturous_bloom.gui: Manifests a budding flower under a target enemy that blooms through concentric water ripples and inflicts poison, wither, and slowness before detonating in a petal shockwave.
ui.ironspell_more.rapturous_bloom_alread: Target area is already occupied by a blooming flower.
spell.ironspell_more.crimson_thornbind.g: Launches a connected crimson vine horizontally from your hand. It stops at the first enemy, deals magic damage, and raises one vertical root that binds the target for 10 seconds with Wither and Slowness. The path cannot hit additional targets and fades when the surge reaches its endpoint. While bound, attacks from the caster cause the thorns to deal bonus rend damage.
spell.ironspell_more.jade_aura.guide: Unleash a resonant surge of jade energy that empowers you and optionally a targeted ally. Grants the Jade Aura effect, increasing attack damage, movement speed, and spell power. Aiming at an ally buffs both the ally and yourself; aiming elsewhere buffs only yourself.
spell.ironspell_more.gilded_hare.guide: Manifest the agile flowing spirit of the golden hare, sprouting ribbon rabbit ears and ankle ribbon wraps. Disperses faint golden dust, granting Speed I, Jump Boost I, Attack Speed (+10%), Absorption, and Strength I for 2 minutes. Melee kicks inflict Slowness I (1s) and Ribbon Binding on target. Landing 5 consecutive hits wraps the enemy in a full ribbon cocoon, inflicting complete Stun for 1s and Blindness for 3s.
ui.ironspell_more.gilded_hare.buffs: Self Buff: Speed, Jump Boost, Attack Speed (+10%), Absorption, Strength
